name: everything-exam-preparation
description: Multiple-skill exam preparation and Online Essay Exam drafting plugin for course material, practice papers, Online Materials, and Extra Reading.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare exams with notes, reports, worked solutions, and online essay drafting.
interface.longDescription: Everything Exam Preparation routes course material, lecture files, practice papers, Online Materials, and Extra Reading into focused exam-prep workflows. It supports explanation notes, MCQ and short-answer reports, long-answer and practical preparation, worked solutions, essay enrichment, Online Essay Exam drafting, question solving, and question organization while preserving the existing review gates.
defaultPrompt: Prepare exam notes and reports from these lecture and past-paper files.
Draft an Online Essay Exam answer using the allowed source materials.
Organize these past-paper questions by lecture knowledge unit.
